recipes.name: Blini Pancakes
recipes.notes: Source: TheMealDB id 53080. Free for commercial use. https://www.themealdb.com/

steps.title: Step 1
steps.instruction: In a large bowl, whisk together 1/2 cup buckwheat flour, 2/3 cup all-purpose flour, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1 teaspoon yeast.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.instruction: Make a well in the center and pour in 1 cup warm milk, whisking until the batter is smooth.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.instruction: Cover the bowl and let the batter rise until doubled, about 1 hour.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.instruction: Stir 2 tablespoons melted butter and 1 egg yolk into the batter.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.instruction: In a separate bowl, whisk 1 egg white until stiff, but not dry.

steps.title: Step 7
steps.instruction: Fold the whisked egg white into the batter.

steps.title: Step 8
steps.instruction: Cover the bowl and let the batter stand 20 minutes.

steps.title: Step 10
steps.instruction: Heat butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat.

steps.title: Step 11
steps.instruction: Drop quarter-sized dollops of batter into the pan, being careful not to overcrowd the pan. Cook for about 1 minute or until bubbles form.

steps.title: Step 12
steps.instruction: Turn and cook for about 30 additional seconds.

steps.title: Step 13
steps.instruction: Remove the finished blini onto a plate and cover them with a clean kitchen towel to keep warm. Add more butter to the pan and repeat the frying process with the remaining batter.
